Notes: Battery connector, upright THT, true 2.54 mm pin pitch so it drops straight into the 2.54 mm hole spacing. Bare 1x2 mm exposed SMD copper pads on the PCB for soldering wires directly to. This is board copper, not a purchased part, so there is nothing to source and no cost.
